ab.duration_basis: Assumes company kurta traffic is 25× the bot-filtered September sample. Uses both arms and all eligible sessions, before clustering inflation.

experiments.release_rule: Report whether the frozen challenger improved October overall without regressing on exchange cases. The generator emits the incumbent independently of the October scores.
experiments.validation_target: Observed acceptable size (one known kept or exchanged-to size per historical row)
